sentences.en: The Prime Minister was obliged to resign from the Cabinet.
sentences.zh: 总理被迫辞去了内阁职务。

sentences.en: He failed to become a cabinet member at that time.
sentences.zh: 他当时没有成为内阁成员。

sentences.zh: 药柜里有一瓶大剂量的阿司匹林。
